profile.headline: Security Automation Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Practiced Security Automation and Site Reliability Engineer with expertise in building scalable, secure systems at Apple. Experienced in Python, Golang, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure management. Passionate about solving complex technical challenges and improving system reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and built a Python-based Slack bot that automates user feedback collection for enhanced security measures.
* Mentored a junior engineer on code quality, focusing on long-term best practices in software development.
* Led a team of developers through the planning and roadmap phases for a web API
* Collaborated across teams to review the deployment and scaling of a system identity API, prior to the launch of Apple Intelligence at WWDC.

positions.title: Security Automation Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
* Founding member of an embedded security team responsible for enhancing an SRE organization.
* Built Golang-based tools that empower SREs to execute commands concurrently across thousands of hosts.
* Developed Python scripts integrated into Jenkins pipelines for inventory analysis.
* Created Splunk reports used by upper management to monitor organizational progress on kernel and OS migrations.
* Partnered with PCI/SOX compliance experts to create tools that facilitated the identification and auditing of compliance violations.
* Created Splunk reports that played a crucial role in our incident response to the log4shell vulnerability.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
* SRE on a central tools team responsible for bare-metal provisioning at scale.
* Tech lead in the design of a large-scale configuration management system.
* Managed one of the largest open-source Puppet deployments, including code reviews and migrations.
* Created Ruby-based CI/CD tooling, used across teams, for ensuring a safe and stable migration of Puppet code across several major versions.
* Participated in a rotating on-call schedule to ensure system reliability and support.

positions.title: Sr System Administrator
positions.description:
Reduced outages from 2-3/week for an hour each time, to 1-2/month for a couple minutes each time, providing greater stability and system alerting, notifying ops there was a problem before customers realized.

 * Lead a small team to reduce downtime of user-facing game servers and our primary website
 * Contributed code and user support to the Sensu open source monitoring software
 * Maintained server infrastructure in a global, mission-critical, production online game environment
 * Collaborated with hardware vendors to increase the performance and reliability of our infrastructure
 * Managed large, highly available, mysql servers (>1TB)

Other achievements:

 * Collaborated with developers to build systems that allowed them to focus on game features
 * Collaborated with leadership to fulfill in-house IT needs               
 * Trained and prepared overseas datacenter teams to enable them in maintaining our infrastructure                             
 * Participated in a rotating on-call schedule                                                       
 * Reduced downtime and increased reliability of thousands of servers by designing and implementing a monitoring/metric system
 * Developed and maintained Salt configuration management code for thousands of servers                          
 * Collaborated with developers to create Jenkins pipelines to build and deploy websites to Zend

positions.title: Linux System Administrator
positions.description:
Key member in a small team tasked with developing the infrastructure for an online multiplayer game prior to launch at PAX.

 * Maintained server infrastructure in a global, mission-critical, production environment
 * Deployed and used the Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana stack to troubleshoot and resolve production incidents
 * Wrote and maintained Puppet code for web servers, app servers, load balancers, and monitoring tools (Graphite, Sensu, etc.)

Other achievements:

 * Reduced downtime and increased reliability of thousands of servers by designing and implementing a monitoring/metric system
 * Developed a distributed git-based deployment system to enable game developers to push updates and other fixes                               
 * Collaborated on designing and implementing a HAProxy-based load balancing system for routing traffic based on customer geolocation                            
 * Developed Jenkins pipelines to build and deploy software                             
 * Participated in a rotating on-call schedule

positions.title: Linux System Administrator
positions.description:
* Developed and operated infrastructure for the hosting of 100+ websites
 * Collaborated with customers in updating and ensuring the reliability of their websites
 * Was the sole operator of a 24/7 on-call schedule to ensure system uptime

Other achievements:

 * Stabilized the web services by moving the servers to VMware vSphere
 * Designed and implemented a web service for improved performance using nginx and php­fpm
 * Installed and configured Nagios to monitor system interruptions/malfunctions
 * Implemented an automatic file backup system
 * Tuned a MySQL server for 5 times faster page load­time

positions.title: Student Tech
positions.description: Developed tooling to deploy a system used by students on campus computers to run Windows/Linux on the OS X machines.

positions.title: Staff Technologist
positions.description: Web developer and front desk greeter for a non-profit organization providing food and social services to the local unhoused community.

positions.title: Staff Technologist
positions.description: Web developer and PC restoration specialist for a non-profit organization supporting unhoused families.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Backend PHP developer of a bespoke Content Management System (CMS) for a small, boutique, web development studio.
